Firth logistic missingness contrast analysis facade

Source: R/ContrastsFacades.R
ContrastsFirthFacade.Rd

Encapsulates the pipeline: encode missingness -> build_model_glm_protein -> ContrastsFirth.

Requires aggregated (protein-level) LFQData. For nested peptide-level input use ContrastsBinomialFirthNestedFacade.

Contrasts are Wald tests on the log odds of detection with the normal reference distribution (z, df = Inf), as in the coefficient table, confint() and logistf itself. With few samples the test is conservative: in a null simulation with 10 samples per group and detection probability 0.5, 4.1% of the p-values fell below 0.05.

Value

An R6 class generator.

Examples

istar <- sim_lfq_data_protein_config(n_proteins = 20, weight_missing = 0.5)
#> `protein_Id`: columns `proteinID`, `idtype2` united with separator '~'.
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> setup_analysis: dropped 5 unconfigured columns: average_prot_abundance, sd, mean, N, Replicate.
#> setup_analysis: added 51 rows with NA response for feature and sample combinations absent from the input.
lfqdata <- LFQData$new(istar$data, istar$config)
contrasts <- c("A_vs_Ctrl" = "group_A - group_Ctrl")
fa <- ContrastsFirthFacade$new(lfqdata, "~ group_", contrasts)
head(fa$get_contrasts())
